d: On the one hand the modest house of Miller, on the other rustic little church: in the distance, and through trees, the peaks of Walter's castle. A very clear spring dawn is on the horizon: the village dwellers gather to celebrate the Christmas day of Luisa. Laura is among them.
Room in Walter's castle, with door at the back. Walter and Wurm. Some Family, who remain beyond the threshold.
The Duchess enters with followers of Damigelle, Paggi, Famigliari, Arcieri.

Inside Miller's house. Two side doors: one puts at Miller's room, the other at Luisa's; next to the first hangs a sword and an old soldier's seat; in the prospect the entrance and a window from which I glimpsed a part of the church. Odonsi for the mountains and the surrounding valleys shouts, and rumbling of hunting instruments. Voices in the distance.
He was led by Archers, followed by Laura and many peasants.
Inside Miller's house. Laura and peasants, then Luisa.
The Duchess sits, trying to compose herself from her disturbance. Walter opens a secret door, from where Luisa comes out, accompanied by Wurm.
The hanging garden of the castle. It leads to the bottom of the apartments of Rodolfo. Rodolfo is rushed from an apartment. Luisa's sheet is in her hands; a farmer follows him.
Armigeri and Familiari go all over, so Walter.

Miller's house: the window is open, and through it you can see the temple internally illuminated. Luisa writes at a table, on which a lamp burns: she starts on the table herself a basket with fruit, and a cup full of milk; in a song of the room Laura and other Landscapes, which mestatively contemplate Luisa.
All the other characters, and sayings.
